UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_StudioResetCategor: Restore this MOD's defaults for this category; vanilla map-engine options stay unchanged
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_NeedFramework: The settings window needs a newer Minidoracat UI Framework. All settings can still be changed in ESC › Options › MOD.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_LayerSwitch_toolti: Turns the whole category on or off. Off hides it on both maps; on brings back the maps it shows on by default. To pick each map, use "Show on" below.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMLayersOffNote: Map layers are turned off for the world map right now (MiniMap button at the bottom right of the world map › Map layers), so the World map choice does nothing until you turn them back on.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_LayerNamesWorld: Show names on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_MapImagery_tooltip: Overlay the map with imagery rendered from the actual in-game look (this MOD's core visual). Turn it off to fall back to the vanilla vector style on both the mini-map and world map; icons, resource points, zombie dots and every other feature keep working.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMPanelBtn: MiniMap: map imagery and layer toggles for the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMLayersEsc: Show map layers on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMLayers_tooltip: Uncheck to hide everything MiniMap draws on the world map at once: resource points, parking lots, custom zones, safehouses, zombie, animal and vehicle icons, and add-on layers. Each layer keeps its own "Show on" choices; check this again to bring them back. Home, favorites, navigation and the map imagery are not affected. The MiniMap button at the bottom right of the world map has this same option.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_Players: Show my player marker on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_Players_tooltip: Show your own position marker on the mini-map. The world map's marker is in the world map's own options (gear button).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PlayerFacing_toolt: Turns your position marker into an arrow that points where your character faces; in a vehicle it points where the vehicle faces. Works on the mini-map and the world map while your own marker is shown.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PlayerCone_tooltip: Adds a faint cone behind the facing arrow so it is easier to see which way a character faces. It is not the game's real field of view. Your cone is red; other players' cones match their arrow color.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemotePlayers: Show teammate markers on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemotePlayers_tool: Show other players and their names on the mini-map. Multiplayer only. The world map's markers are in the world map's own options (gear button).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemoteFacing: Show which way other players face
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemoteFacing_toolt: Nearby teammates (same faction or safehouse) get a cyan arrow, other players a white one. The server decides who is shown; players far away stay a plain red dot.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_FloorMarks_tooltip: Other players and zombie dots that are not on your floor are drawn differently: zombie dots fade, and other players' arrows follow the "Floor mark style". Someone on the stairs counts as the floor below. In multiplayer the server can turn it off (sandbox option "Allow floor marks", on by default).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_FloorMarkStyle_too: BFH style: arrows on your floor keep their size; arrows on other floors are smaller, bright when the player is above you and dark when below. BF6 style: arrows keep their size and get a small black triangle inside, pointing up when the player is above you and down when below; a larger "Marker size" makes it easier to see. Only affects other players; zombie dots on other floors fade in both styles.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZombieIntensity_to: Overlay the zombie population heatmap on the mini-map. This shows population density, not live zombie positions; in multiplayer the client may not have this data.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PlaceNames_tooltip: Show town and area names on the mini-map. Enabling this also turns on "Symbols" in the mini-map gear panel (name rendering is gated by the symbols layer).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZombieDots: Show zombie dots on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZombieDots_tooltip: Draw orange dots on the mini-map for real-time zombie positions (orange to stand apart from the red player marker). Only zombies within the mini-map view are shown (adjustable limit, 200 by default; zombies nearest to you are prioritized when over the limit; sampled every 0.3s). Performance cost grows with the dot limit setting and nearby zombie count; off = zero cost.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_Safehouses_tooltip: Outline safehouse areas on the maps where safehouses are shown: green for safehouses you belong to (owner or invited member), cyan for faction members', red for other players'. Helps you spot restricted areas. Only drawn when safehouses exist (mainly multiplayer).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SafehouseIcons_too: Draw a house icon at the centre of each safehouse area: green for your own, cyan for faction members', red for other players'. Shares the server's safehouse area display mode and distance with the outlines.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SafehouseNames_too: Draw the safehouse name at the centre of the area (below the icon when shown). When the name differs from the owner's username (e.g. a custom name), the owner's username follows in parentheses. Limited by the server's "Safehouse name display" mode and name distance, independent from the outlines.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SafehouseOnWorld: Show safehouses on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_StreetNames_toolti: Draw street names along roads on the mini-map. The vanilla mini-map never loads street data (only the world map does); this mod loads it, so street-name translation mods apply as well. Hidden when the mini-map is zoomed far out (view more than about 8x wider than default): labels get too cramped to read and slow down the frame.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_NavRoute: Show the navigation route on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_NavRoute_tooltip: After you set a navigation target (right-click), a road-following route is computed and drawn on the mini-map beneath the target flag; the world map has its own switch. Uses the official street data of loaded maps; falls back to the straight-line indicator where no road data exists. With both maps off, no route is computed.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMNavRoute: Show the navigation route on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_KeepFinishedTrip_t: Off by default. When off, the numbered stop markers disappear from the mini-map and the world map once you reach the last stop of a trip; the Itinerary window still shows the finished trip. Turn on to keep the markers (green with a check mark = arrived, grey with a slash = skipped) until you start a new trip. Either way, adding a stop or setting a new navigation target after a trip has finished starts a new trip numbered from 1.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ChunkGrid_tooltip: Mark every chunk (8x8 tiles; the game saves the world chunk by chunk) on the mini-map and the world map: neighbouring chunks get alternating shading and grid lines, and the chunk you stand in is outlined in amber with its chunk number and coordinate range. Zoom in until the text fits to label every chunk with its number; the grid hides itself when zoomed out too far to read. Off by default.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ChunkGridLabels_to: When the chunk grid is shown, also draw its text: the number and coordinate range of the chunk you stand in, and each chunk's number when zoomed in. Turn off to keep only the shading, grid lines and the amber outline of your chunk. On by default.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_BtnSearch: Search map: coordinates, street name, facility type or favorite name; also manage home & favorites and plan your multi-stop itinerary here
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SearchHint: Enter a street/facility name or coordinates (x,y or x,y,z)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SearchEmptyHint: Type a place name or coordinates; pick a result to add it to your trip.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SearchReenterWorld: Re-enter the save to retry streets.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripManualHint: Stop road routing and show a direct line to the current target. Use when no road route is available or you want to travel off-road yourself. Guidance only: it does not walk or drive for you.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripRoadsHint: Keep the current target and itinerary, and plan a fresh road route from your position. Stop the vehicle and disengage autodrive first. This does not start autodrive. If no road route is found, you can switch back to straight-line guidance.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripConfirmClearBr: The saved itinerary is damaged. Clear it and start over?
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripEmptyHint: Search a place, or right-click the map, then use “Add to end of trip”.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripDataErrorHint: The damaged saved itinerary is kept for diagnosis. Set a navigation target again to rebuild it.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripConfirmReplace: Replace the whole itinerary with “%1” and start navigating there now?
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripModeUnsupporte: This build has no continuation-mode setting for itineraries.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripModeNeedTrip: Add a stop first, then choose a continuation mode.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripPreview_disabl: Trip preview unavailable (road-following navigation is off)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripPreview_idle: Trip preview: waiting for road data
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripPreview_noroad: Trip preview: no road between some stops
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripPreviewDist: whole trip approx. %1 by road (incl. off-road links)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripError_state: The current itinerary state does not allow this
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripError_stale: Itinerary changed meanwhile; nothing was applied
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripError_busy: Auto-drive is in control; stop it first
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripError_notdrive: You must be the driver of that vehicle
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripError_notstopp: Bring the vehicle to a full stop first
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripError_unsuppor: Saved itinerary format is not supported
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TripError_noroad: No road route to that stop
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AnimalWild: Show wild animals on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AnimalWild_tooltip: Draw icons on the mini-map for nearby wild animals (deer, rabbits, raccoons, rodents...). Green tint / green corner mark = wild. Sampled every 0.5s; only loaded animals within the mini-map view are shown.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AnimalLivestock_to: Draw mini-map icons for nearby livestock (cows, sheep, pigs, chickens, etc.). The server may restrict visibility by the safehouse the animal is currently inside, or disable livestock icons entirely. This is a display rule, not animal ownership.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AnimalNames_toolti: Label each animal icon with its type (e.g. "Calf"; custom name if set) plus male/female. Refreshed with the icon sampling every 0.5s.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_VehicleDots_toolti: Draw a steering-wheel icon on the mini-map for vehicles within view (the game has no built-in car-shaped map glyph; the steering wheel is the closest vanilla symbol, tinted cyan). Sampled every 0.5s.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMZombieDots: Show zombie dots on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMAnimalWild: Show wild animals on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMAnimalLivestock: Show livestock on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMVehicleDots: Show vehicles on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WM_tooltip: Show on the world map (M). Style, colors and filters are shared with the mini-map settings. Only loaded entities near players are drawn, so zooming out never floods the map.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMCell_tooltip: Show on the world map (M). Style, size and filters are shared with the mini-map.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_LivestockHiddenByS: Livestock visibility is set to "Hide all"
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SafehouseHiddenByS: Safehouse area display is disabled by the server
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SafehouseNamesHidd: Safehouse name display is disabled by the server
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AnimalSpeciesFilte: Written automatically by the species checkboxes in the mini-map settings window (CSV of hidden species; empty = show all). Normally no need to edit by hand.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_VehicleCategoryFil: Written automatically by the vehicle category checkboxes in the mini-map settings window (CSV of hidden categories; empty = show all).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_LockPosition_toolt: When locked, the mini-map cannot be moved by dragging the title bar nor resized by dragging its edges. Prevents accidental drags.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_FloatIcon_tooltip: An on-screen button that toggles the mini-map on click (no hotkey needed). It sits in the family toolbar when available; otherwise it is a floating icon you can hold and drag to reposition, and the position is remembered.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_TextAnnotations_to: The vanilla mini-map uses a compact symbols mode that never draws text annotations such as place names. Enable to use the full symbols mode: text annotations can render (place names still require "Show place names" and "Symbols" in the gear panel), and player-drawn map symbols render at full size, which may look large up close.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ClickOpenWorldMap: Click mini-map to open world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ClickOpenWorldMap_: Vanilla behavior: a click (without dragging) on the mini-map opens the world map. Off by default; the M key and the M button on the button bar still work.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_FreeLook_tooltip: After dragging, the mini-map stays where you panned; click the mini-map to snap back to your player. Disable for vanilla behavior (snaps back on release).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ShowPlayerCoords_t: Show your current x, y, z at the bottom center of the mini-map and the world map (M). The XY button and the right-click menu can copy coordinates regardless of this setting.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_BtnPerspective: Toggle view: isometric (matches the game view) / top-down (north up)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_GhostMode_tooltip: Clicks, scroll wheel and right-clicks pass through the mini-map to the game world, and the map body and frame turn semi-transparent — enlarge the map as a permanent overlay without blocking play. Amber border while active. Toggle: this option, the hotkey (default '), or right-click the mini-map toggle button. In split-screen this affects all players.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_Places: Show home & favorites on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_Places_tooltip: On by default. When off, home and favorite icons and names are not drawn on the mini-map; the world map has its own switch. Go Home, the Favorites tab and the right-click menu still work.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMPlaces: Show home & favorites on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SharedTargets: Show faction-shared targets on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_SharedTargets_tool: On by default. When off, navigation targets shared with you by faction members (flags and routes) are not drawn on the mini-map; the world map has its own switch. Received shares are kept and reappear when you turn this back on.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMSharedTargets: Show faction-shared targets on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemoteAuthorsNote: Selected authors are shown; deselect one to hide their symbols. The list is stored on the server and is the same one as "Hide Author's Symbols" in the vanilla Sharing panel.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemoteNoAuthors: No other player is sharing map symbols with you right now.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemoteTrustedOnly: Only faction and safehouse members' symbols
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemoteTrustedOnly_: Shows only symbols shared by players in your faction or your safehouse; other players who share later are hidden too. With no faction and no safehouse, no other player's symbols are shown. Turning on a player outside your faction and safehouse in the author list turns this off.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemoteShowAll_tool: Turns on Remote Symbols, turns off the faction and safehouse filter, and shows every author in the list again, including ones you hid.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RemoteListCount: %1 in total, %2 match, %3 of them hidden
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_MarkerLayers_toolt: Written automatically by the add-on categories of the gear settings window (layer on/off, size and names); only layers you changed are stored. Clear this field to restore every layer's defaults.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ResetSize_tooltip: Clear the custom width/height written by edge-drag resizing and return to the square shape of the size preset above.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_CustomSize_tooltip: Written automatically when you drag the mini-map edges to resize (e.g. 300x240). Takes priority over the size preset above. Clear this field, or change the size preset, to reset.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_MapBounds_tooltip: Outline the area of each enabled map MOD on the mini-map and world map (in the chosen color), with its name at the center. Makes MOD maps easy to locate.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_MapPackLayers_tool: Mount and display the MOD map images provided by a map pack. When off, only the base map image remains (outlines are unaffected). The mini-map rebuilds immediately; the world map applies on next load.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneLayer: Show custom zones on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneLayer_tooltip: Highlight custom zones supplied by a zone-layer add-on (such as server regions) with a translucent fill, border and name on the mini-map; the world map has its own switch. Affects only custom zones, not resource points. This is the master gate for every zone add-on; if an add-on ships its own toggle, both must be on for its zones to show. On servers with many zones, use the "Custom zone display distance" slider to show only nearby zones.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMZoneLayer: Show custom zones on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneNames_tooltip: Turn off to hide custom-zone text labels. Fills, borders, and icons remain visible. Does not affect resource points.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneNamesFar_toolt: Checked (default): custom zone names show at any zoom level, so zones are easy to locate from afar. Unchecked: small zones show their names only when zoomed in (matching POI behavior). Affects custom zones only, not resource points.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneCategoryFilter: Comma-separated zone categories to hide (the category checkboxes in the unified settings window write this automatically; empty = show all). Categories come from the "category" field in the server's zones.json.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ZoneNoCats: No categorized zones yet (servers can add a "category" field to zones in zones.json)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiIcons: Show resource points on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiIcons_tooltip: Mark resource points (military, police, gun store and 20 categories in total) with icons on the mini-map; which buildings are marked depends on "Marking method". The world map has its own switch. With both maps off, resource blocks are hidden too. Toggle individual categories under "Resource categories" below.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMPoiIcons: Show resource points on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiBlocks_tooltip: Additionally outline resource point areas with a translucent block and name (off by default). Independent from icons; both can be on at once.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ParkingLayer: Show parking lots on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ParkingLayer_toolt: Marks parking lots on the mini-map with a blue area and a P icon; the world map has its own switch. Icon size, opacity and display distance follow the resource point settings.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_WMParkingLayer: Show parking lots on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_ParkingHow: How lots are found: from the map's vehicle spawn spots. Areas with painted parking lines or room for 6 or more cars are marked as parking lots; single spots and home driveways are not. On the vanilla map, street-side parking and spots on grass are left out too. This is automatic, so a few places may be wrong or missing.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiColorIcons_tool: Draw resource point icons in full color. Checked: full-color icons. Unchecked (default): a monochrome silhouette tinted by the category color. Affects icons only.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiWholeBuilding_t: Checked (default): the whole building is drawn as one block. Unchecked: only the category's own rooms. Requires "Show resource blocks"; icon placement and display distance are both unaffected. On large buildings (malls) the whole-building area can be far larger than the actual shop area.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiSource_tooltip: How resource points are marked. By main use: each building gets one main use, and small rooms inside homes are left out; covers the vanilla map and the map mods in a map pack. By room: a building is marked if any one of its rooms is of that type, can be in several types, and every map mod is covered, so more places are marked. Both go by room names, not the vanilla map's building colors. Server setting: follows the server's sandbox option (in single player, this save's sandbox settings). If the server locks everyone to the default, this choice is ignored until it is unlocked.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiSourceNoteMinim: Each building gets one main use, and small rooms tucked inside homes are left out, so only places worth a trip are marked. Covers the vanilla map and the map mods in a map pack.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiSourceNoteRooms: A building is marked if any one of its rooms is of that type, and can be in several types. Every map mod is covered and more places are marked; a home bar in a house, for example, is marked as Food / Dining. Blocks always cover the whole building.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiSourceBasis: Both go by room names, which are also what the game uses to decide what items spawn there; neither follows the vanilla map's building colors.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PoiSourceLocked: The server locks everyone to the default marking method; you can't change it.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_DistNote: Value = your setting / server cap; the lower one applies. 0 = no limit
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_EscDistanceNote: Display distance in each category: 0 = no limit. If the server sets a limit, the smaller value applies.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfIntro: Normally light: with resource point, zombie, animal and vehicle icons all on, the mini-map adds only about 0.4 ms per frame on average (about 2 percent at 60 FPS; default settings cost less). The more it shows on screen, the more it costs; layers you turn off cost nothing.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfZoom: Zooming out costs more: with a whole town or the entire map on screen, over a thousand resource points have to be drawn, noticeably heavier than normal zoom.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescMap: Drawn directly by the game engine; almost no impact
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescPoi: Light at normal zoom; heavier the further you zoom out and the more points are on screen. Showing only the categories you need helps
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescZone: Heavier with more server-defined zones; use the custom zone display distance to show only nearby ones
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescZombie: Heavier with more zombies around and a higher dot cap (100-800); off by default
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescAnimal: Positions update every 0.5s, at most 100 shown; off by default
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescMisc: Few items, or calculated only when needed; small impact
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescStreet: Heavier with more streets on screen; hidden automatically when the mini-map is zoomed far out
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDescChunk: Shown only when zoomed in, with a cap on how many; off by default
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfNoteWorldmap: The world map (M) costs more than the corner mini-map while open; closing it brings performance back.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfGame: The User Interface (UI) tab in the game options matters too: keep "UI Offscreen Rendering" on, since turning it off redraws the whole UI every frame. If it lags, lower "UI Rendering FPS" from the default 60 to 30 (the UI will move less smoothly).
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfDebug: Launching the game with -debug makes all Lua mods slower (the mini-map takes about 15-30 percent longer); you do not need it for normal play.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PerfAdvice: If it feels laggy, try in order: do not zoom the mini-map out too far; turn off zombie dots or lower their cap; show only the resource point categories you need and shrink display distances; lower "UI Rendering FPS".
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AdminNote: This server allows admin view overrides. These switches only change what your own client draws; they never change server settings and are not an anti-cheat feature. They reset when you leave or reconnect.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AdminTactical_tool:
Temporarily ignores the server-wide switches for zombie dots, the zombie heatmap, animal icons and vehicle icons, plus the zombie / animal / vehicle / POI / custom zone display distances and the global distance cap.
Requires the server option "Allow admin tactical view override" and the CanSeeAll capability.
Turning this off also turns off Privacy view.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AdminPrivacy: Privacy view (ignore other players' privacy limits)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AdminPrivacy_toolt:
On top of Tactical view, also ignores the limits that hide other players' private information: safehouse area / name display and their distance limits, and livestock icon visibility.
Requires the server option "Allow admin privacy view override" and Tactical view already on.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_AdminPrivacyDisabl: This server does not allow admin privacy view
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_BtnGoHome: Go home: replace the current trip with home and start navigating
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_HomeNotSet: No home set yet. Right-click a spot on the map and choose “Favorites” › “Set as home”.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PlaceNameTitle: Favorite name (leave blank to show coordinates)
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PlacesEmpty: No favorites yet. Right-click the map and choose “Favorites” › “Add to favorites…”, or right-click a search result and choose “Add to favorites…”.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_PlaceError_unsuppo: Favorites were saved by a newer version of this mod. Update the mod to edit them.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadRecordHint: Drive along the road you want to keep. Press "Stop recording" to check and trim it on the world map before saving. Width and surface are measured where possible.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadEmpty: No custom roads yet. Press "Draw new road" to draw one on the map, or "Record road" to record one while driving.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadReadOnly_unrea: The road file could not be read. Roads are read-only until it can be read again.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadReadOnly_unsup: Your roads were saved by a newer version of the mod. Update the mod to edit them.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadRecordLost: Your last recording was interrupted (death or leaving the game). The recorded points were not kept.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadConfirmDelete: Delete the custom road "%1"? Navigation will stop using it.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadNoRoadHint: No road leads to this stop. You can draw a custom road to it, or choose "Use straight-line guidance" under "Actions…" on the itinerary page.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadConfirmDeleteS: Delete the custom road "%1"? It is shared with your faction or safehouse; the share will be withdrawn too. Navigation will stop using it.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadConfirmDiscard: Discard this unsaved road? It cannot be recovered.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadPreviewNoStops: Trip preview: no stops left to go
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadLayerMini: Show custom roads on the mini-map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadLayerWorld: Show custom roads on the world map
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadLayer_tooltip: Draws roads you drew or recorded, and roads others shared with you, on the mini-map following their surface and width; the look is set by "Style". The world map has its own switch. Only changes what is shown; navigation still uses the roads.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadNames_tooltip: Writes the name next to each road. Roads shared by others also show the author; roads not used for navigation are marked "(not used for navigation)".
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadReceived_toolt: Roads that faction or safehouse members shared with you, outlined in blue. Turning this off only hides them; navigation still uses them.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadDisabled: Show roads not used for navigation
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadDisabled_toolt: Roads set to "Not used for navigation" are drawn fainter.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadStyle_tooltip: Road surface: drawn like a real road, following its width and surface. Outlined corridor: see-through fill with both edges outlined, so the map shows through. Map line: fixed thickness that does not widen when you zoom in.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadMinWidth_toolt: When the map is zoomed out, roads are drawn at least this wide on screen so narrow roads stay visible.
UI_MinidoracatMiniMap_RoadHintDraw: Left-click: add point   Right-click: undo   Enter: done   Esc: exit (the line is kept)   Hold Shift: no snapping
